title: PaymentSlipUploader → 直接上傳至 S3 (整合)

findings: PaymentSlipUploader rewritten with presigned URL flow — 3 steps: presigned-url → PUT to S3 → confirm
Client-side file type validation (JPEG/PNG/WebP/PDF) before API call
Client-side file size validation (10MB limit) before API call
Upload progress bar using XMLHttpRequest progress events
Inline error messages using AlertCircle icon (no alert())
Success state: green check + localized success message
i18n support: EN, ZH-HK, ZH-CN dictionary keys in paymentUpload section
Confirmation page updated: locale-aware dict prop, registrantId + email params
EnrollmentWizard fixed: redirect param from orderId → registrantId, guest email forwarding
End-to-end test verified: file upload to S3 succeeded, DB paymentProofUrl populated
evidence.residual: Admin preview panel for uploaded proof (presigned GET URL) not yet implemented. S3 CORS config needed for production.

acceptance: Update PaymentSlipUploader to use presigned URL flow instead of FormData POST to /api/upload-slip
Step 1: Call POST /api/upload/presigned-url to get upload URL
Step 2: PUT file directly to S3 presigned URL (client-side upload, bypass server)
Step 3: Call POST /api/upload/confirm to record paymentProofUrl in DB
Show upload progress bar during client-side PUT
File type validation on client (before API call): reject non-image/PDF
File size validation on client: reject > 10MB
Replace alert() error handling with inline error message using AlertCircle icon
Success state: show green check + 'Payment proof uploaded successfully'
verification: Select PDF file < 10MB → upload progress bar → success message. Select 15MB file → client-side error. Select .exe file → rejected on client. Check DB: paymentProofUrl populated.
